title: Customer Pilot Feedback Template — Redwood Private DR (Backup/Restore Toolkit)
linked_artifacts: Linear: ENG-4821 (Epic: Day-2 Ops Toolkit: Backup/Restore)
content:
Purpose
Use this template to capture structured feedback from Private DR toolkit pilots (VPC + on-prem). This is meant to be filled out live during a scheduled backup/restore pilot session (or immediately after), and then posted back to the pilot Linear issue.

Audience
- Solutions / Pro Services: pilot facilitation + customer environment notes
- SRE: restore drill timing, failure modes, observability gaps
- Eng Private Deployments: installer/helm/terraform friction + bugs
- Security/Compliance: key handling + evidence expectations

How to use
1) Create a copy per customer + per pilot session (Backup pilot, Restore drill #1, Restore drill #2, etc.).
2) Fill in as much as possible during the session; don’t try to polish.
3) Attach logs/artifacts (redacted as needed) and record exact timings.
4) At the end, summarize “Top 3 issues” + “Requested changes” with severity.

Appendix — Redaction guidance
- Do NOT paste access tokens, kubeconfigs, private keys, or customer secrets.
- Redact account IDs, bucket names, and KMS key IDs if customer requires; otherwise keep them for engineering triage.
- When in doubt, attach logs separately and confirm acceptable redaction with customer.
